facts.fact: The FY2025/26 estimates give project 12104 MCWBE Computerisation, Ministry of Child Welfare and Basic Education, a development estimate of BWP 270,000,000 from the Domestic Development Fund; revised later to BWP 38,819,833.

The FY2026/27 estimates volume shows actual expenditure of BWP 0 on project 12104 by 5 December 2025, a part-year figure, not an outturn; spending is the ministry's project line, with no collections given.
Cross-vote computerisation had spent BWP 65,419,018 of a revised BWP 300,336,741 (21.8%) by 5 December 2025, a part-year figure.
